description: This file defines an abstract base class 'BaseLLMAdapter' for integrating with different large language model (LLM) providers. It provides an interface for converting context and tools into provider-specific formats, managing messages, and creating provider-specific message objects. It uses typing and abstract methods to enforce implementation in subclasses.

classes.name: BaseLLMAdapter
classes.description: An abstract base class that provides the interface and some default implementations for LLM provider adapters, handling message formatting, tool conversions, and parameter extraction.

methods.name: str id_for_llm_specific_messages(self)
methods.description: An abstract property that returns the identifier for LLM-specific messages for this provider.

methods.name: TLLMInvocationParams get_llm_invocation_params(self, context: LLMContext, **kwargs)
methods.description: An abstract method to obtain provider-specific invocation parameters from a universal LLM context.

methods.name: List[Any] to_provider_tools_format(self, tools_schema: ToolsSchema)
methods.description: An abstract method to convert the standardized tools schema into the provider-specific format.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] get_messages_for_logging(self, context: LLMContext)
methods.description: An abstract method that returns messages from the context formatted for logging about the provider.

methods.name: LLMSpecificMessage create_llm_specific_message(self, message: Any)
methods.description: Creates an LLM-specific message object based on a given message.

methods.name: List[LLMContextMessage] get_messages(self, context: LLMContext)
methods.description: Retrieves all messages from the context, including standard and provider-specific messages.

methods.name: List[Any]|NotGiven from_standard_tools(self, tools: Any)
methods.description: Converts tools from standard format to provider-specific format, or returns the original if it is not in a standard format.

ctags.pattern: /^    def get_messages_for_logging(self, context: LLMContext) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:$/
